props.gloss_en: the baraita, middle clause: [a slave goes out] not with a bell on his neck but with one on his garment, and this and that receive impurity
the baraita: an animal does not go out with a seal on its neck or on its garment, nor with a bell on its garment or on its neck
the baraita: this and that [the animal's seal and bell] do not receive impurity
the bell of an animal is impure
and that of a door is pure
a door's [bell] that one made for an animal is impure
an animal's [bell] that one made for a door, even though he attached it to the door and fixed it with nails, is impure
for all vessels descend into their impurity by thought
and they ascend from their impurity only by a change of action
no difficulty: this [the bell that is impure] where it has a clapper, that [the bell that does not receive impurity] where it has no clapper
R' Yonatan: a sound-maker among metal vessels is impure
R' Yonatan: as it says 'every thing (davar) that comes into the fire you shall pass through the fire' (Num 31:23) -- even speech (dibbur) comes into the fire
one who makes bells for a mortar, a cradle, mantles of scrolls or children's wraps: if they have a clapper they are impure
if they have no clapper they are pure
if their clappers were removed, their impurity still remains on them
that [no clapper, pure] applies to a child['s bells]
for they make it [a child's bell] for the sound
but for an adult it is an ornament, even though it has no clapper

supports.gloss_en: שכל הכלים יורדין לידי טומאתן במחשבה ואין עולין מידי טומאתן אלא בשינוי מעשה -- re-designating it for a door is thought, not a change of action
כדרבי שמואל בר נחמני אמר רבי יונתן -- a metal vessel that makes sound is a vessel, so the clapper can make the bell one
שנאמר כל דבר אשר יבא באש -- אפילו דבור יבא באש
